title: User Trajectory Prediction Unifying Global and Local Temporal Information
abstract: arXiv:2508.02161v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Trajectory prediction is essential for formulating proactive strategies that anticipate user mobility and support advance preparation. Therefore, how to reduce the forecasting error in user trajectory prediction within an acceptable inference time arises as an interesting issue. However, trajectory data contains both global and local temporal information, complicating the extraction of the complete temporal pattern. Moreover, user behavior occurs over different time scales, increasing the difficulty of capturing behavioral patterns. To address these challenges, a trajectory prediction model based on multilayer perceptron (MLP), multi-scale convolutional neural network (MSCNN), and cross-attention (CA) is proposed. Specifically, MLP is used to extract the global temporal information of each feature. In parallel, MSCNN is employed to extract the local temporal information by modeling interactions among features within a local temporal

translated_title: 统一全局与局部时间信息的用户轨迹预测
translated_abstract: 轨迹预测对于制定预测用户移动性并支持提前准备的主动策略至关重要。因此，如何在可接受的推理时间内减少用户轨迹预测中的预测误差成为一个值得关注的问题。然而，轨迹数据同时包含全局和局部时间信息，这使得提取完整的时间模式变得复杂。此外，用户行为发生在不同的时间尺度上，进一步增加了捕捉行为模式的难度。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于多层感知机（MLP）、多尺度卷积神经网络（MSCNN）和交叉注意力（CA）的轨迹预测模型。具体而言，MLP用于提取每个特征的全局时间信息；与此同时，MSCNN通过建模局部时间范围内特征之间的交互来提取局部时间信息。
tldr: 该论文提出一种融合MLP、多尺度卷积神经网络和交叉注意力的轨迹预测模型，统一提取轨迹数据中的全局与局部时间信息，在保持可接受推理时间的同时降低预测误差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a trajectory prediction model that unifies global and local temporal information extraction using MLP, multi-scale CNN, and cross-attention, reducing forecasting error within an acceptable inference time.
